opportunity_name: Organophosphorus intermediates and derivatives in Taraz
investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: specialty phosphorus producer or qualified foreign technology/equity partner funds Taraz P4 chlorination and derivatives, potentially with an NDFZ supply/JV arrangement. Card USD 80-150m and capacities are ASSUMPTIONS; no bidder or entitlement verified.
buyer_market: EU PBTC/other product-specific formulators and regional industrial scale-inhibitor buyers. FACT: EU PBTC investigation-period consumption 11.3-15.0 kt (S06); neither unserved demand nor a market for the entire derivative package. Regional volumes UNKNOWN.
why_now: FACT: definitive Chinese-origin PBTC duties are 156.7-192.2% in Regulation 2026/2088 (S05); May 2026 measure was provisional (S06). Duty is not producer profit or a blanket measure on all phosphonates. New usable southern chlorine availability remains UNKNOWN.
strongest_realistic_alternative: INFERENCE: DGC Vietnamese P4/chemical chain (Lao Cai and Nghi Son), plus EU conversion of imported P4. DGC construction start evidenced (S04); current operation, same-site integration and comparable delivered quotes UNKNOWN.
deciding_location_factor: Contractable combined P4/chlorine/co-reactant/utility cost and accepted derivative delivery, with defensible trade treatment and capital recovery.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: local P4 conversion could avoid some hazardous upstream freight. No captive feedstock entitlement or power-price advantage established. Historical Sastobe liquid-chlorine plan is supportive evidence to test, not confirmed supply.
scale_view: CALCULATION: if all 30-50 kt/year chlorination output were PCl3, ideal demand is about 23-39 kt chlorine and 6.8-11.3 kt P4 before losses; actual product mix changes this. S02 old 12.1 kt/year liquid-chlorine plan alone cannot cover that configuration. Multi-product customer allocation UNKNOWN.
physical_constraint_view: UNKNOWN: current chlorine surplus/timing, Taraz transport cost, unencumbered P4, co-reactants, firm power/water/gas, route-specific chemical handling. Dedicated chlor-alkali needs dry-NaOH placement at about 1.13 t/t chlorine; do not assume free caustic credit.
captured_status: S01 shows financed Sastobe upstream scope, not an available downstream equity or chlorine slot. No binding capture of the whole assigned derivative decision located; actual foreign entry and input rights UNKNOWN.
economic_return_mechanism: INFERENCE: conversion margin and selected input/logistics savings, conditional on like-for-like costs and product sales. No assumption that the anti-dumping duty becomes margin or survives the full repayment period.
cheapest_kill_test: Can current Sastobe net chlorine sales plus any costed supplementary route and NDFZ uncommitted P4 support the actual product mix at competitive delivered cost?
decisive_evidence: FACT: DBK lists Sastobe under financing (S01). August 2021 official proposal lists 12.1 kt/year liquid chlorine (S02), preventing an all-captive assumption. EU measure retains a capacity-sufficient Union producer finding (S05). Private feedstock allocation remains unverified.
key_unknown: Economically available chlorine/P4 and a real partner slot; comparative combined cost and legally defensible product-specific EU access. Chinese equity neither proves circumvention nor guarantees exemption (S07-S08).
next_test_if_uwt: Proposed owner: addendum commercial reviewer, team to assign. First 45-min supply-document reconciliation of Sastobe net balance, commissioning/commitments, delivered quote and NDFZ P4/site terms. If viable, 60-min matched Taraz/Vietnam/EU cost sheet including caustic outlet and utilities; trade reviewer 45-min origin/Article-13 screen. No contacts made; response time excluded.
pass_condition_if_uwt: Allocable competitive inputs and an accessible capital slot on compatible timing; accepted product basket supports plausible capital recovery versus Vietnam/EU under adverse input/price cases; substantive local production has defensible economic/origin rationale beyond duty avoidance.
kill_or_park_condition_if_uwt: PARK if only speculative caustic sales, subsidies or a short tariff window support economics. FAIL only if evidence establishes unavailable indispensable P4/site rights, no feasible competitive chlorine route, structural cost disadvantage or an applicable trade barrier destroying the required market. Missing documents alone are not FAIL.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: UWT. Real P4 capability and a product-specific regulatory trigger sustain plausibility, but the co-location premise is still a decisive supply/cost proposition. No fatal contradiction proved; no PASS on historical capacity and tariff arithmetic.

investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: homologated Tier-1 fabricator funds bending/lamination/tempering/printing/encapsulation near Almaty or Kostanay buyers, with Kyzylorda substrate/site option. Card 200-250k sets/year is an ASSUMPTION, not proven minimum efficient scale. CAPEX UNKNOWN.
buyer_market: Kazakhstan CKD OEM programmes first; aftermarket and exports not sized or used to close volume gap. FACT: 102,870 passenger vehicles in Jan-Jul 2026 (S09). Actual deletable glass-set demand per model and supplier nomination UNKNOWN.
why_now: FACT: AMMKZ/Kia assembly additions and component-localization agenda (S10). New capacity is not guaranteed accepted glass demand, a subsidy entitlement or an unawarded Tier-1 slot.
strongest_realistic_alternative: Existing qualified China/Korea CKD-kit suppliers first; Avtooyna Uzbekistan and eligible Russian suppliers require model-specific quotes. UzAuto history supports Avtooyna automotive-set production (S15), not free export capacity or all-model homologation.
deciding_location_factor: Delivered OEM-approved set cost after kit deletion credit, lifetime model volume/tooling, qualification, substrate, energy, racks/breakage, stock and documented localization value.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: nearby fabrication may reduce fragile curved-glass freight and inventory. Imported flat substrate might preserve or erase the benefit; neither outcome established. Domestic float manufacture is not automotive fabrication approval.
scale_view: CALCULATION: 102,870 x 12/7 is about 176k passenger vehicles/year, an illustration not forecast or reachable CKD volume. Whole run rate fills about 70-88% of assumed nameplate before eligible share/model fragmentation. S10 177k passenger plan corroborates envelope only; no unverified tooling threshold imposed.
physical_constraint_view: FACT: Orda current catalogue specifies 3-12 mm float (S11), not certified 1.8-2.1 mm OEM substrate. Thin-grade capability, imported-sheet economics, yields, qualified staff and site utility terms UNKNOWN. UN R43 approval does not replace OEM nomination (S14).
captured_status: FACT: Komfort KZT 5.5bn tempered-glass expansion and Orda USD 55m plan exist (S12-S13); published scope neither establishes nor excludes OEM curved/laminated supply. Current nominations and open foreign Tier-1 entry UNKNOWN.
economic_return_mechanism: INFERENCE: freight/rack/breakage/inventory savings and buyer-valued proximity, if sufficient kit deletion credit and awarded lifetime volume recover tooling, qualification and plant capital. No guaranteed OEM offtake or incentive value assumed.
cheapest_kill_test: Does a real unawarded model basket permit glass deletion at a credit and volume sufficient to recover approved local fabrication and tooling cost?
decisive_evidence: FACT: actual passenger output is below aggregate announced capacity (S09-S10). Orda offers float substrate (S11); generic Orda/Komfort expansion descriptions do not resolve OEM capture (S12-S13). Existing regional automotive-glass production is real (S15).
key_unknown: Unawarded model-level nominations, kit deletion credits, tooling amortization and substrate route; these could reverse whether local fabrication merits deeper work.
next_test_if_uwt: Proposed owner: addendum OEM commercial reviewer, team to assign. First 60-min document review of 3-5-year CKD model volumes, BOMs, nomination terms and kit credits. Then 45-min Orda/Komfort equipment/specification/approval scope check; 60-min one-model local versus qualified-import quote comparison, with local/imported substrate and low/base/high volume. No contacts made.
pass_condition_if_uwt: An unawarded, deletable model basket covers vendor-quoted break-even loading after changeovers; accepted local or competitively imported substrate works; local delivered approved sets plausibly recover capital or earn a documented paid service advantage.
kill_or_park_condition_if_uwt: PARK if remaining volumes are too fragmented or approvals miss the useful window. FAIL only on binding capture of the target basket, structurally adverse kit terms, no feasible approved substrate route or demonstrated uncompetitive full cost. Generic tempered-glass plans and missing certificates alone do not establish FAIL.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: UWT. Real assembly demand and a distinct fabrication asset warrant a bounded nomination/cost test. Aggregate capacity, national output and domestic float do not establish reachability, qualification or economic kit substitution.

opportunity_name: Multi-seed Hi-Pro meal and lecithin processing
investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: strategic crusher/feed/ingredient partner funds multi-seed extraction plus incremental deep-dehulling/lecithin capability in northern/eastern Kazakhstan. Test admitted brownfield fallback first; card USD 60-110m greenfield package is an ASSUMPTION, with no present greenfield justification.
buyer_market: EU feed/ingredient customers for accepted meal/lecithin and Chinese/Central Asian oil buyers. FACT: established industry export channels (S19). Reachable premium specifications, bids, volumes and proposed-facility approvals UNKNOWN; FEFAC scenario is not offtake (S24).
why_now: FACT: EU origin-based tariff distinction (S21) and EUDR timing (S23). INFERENCE: non-soy meal may benefit; soy lecithin is not in EUDR soya product list (S22), so direct lecithin compliance premium is unsupported. Reported Russian sunflower certificate suspension is temporary and not durable feedstock protection (S25).
strongest_realistic_alternative: Same Kazakh seed crushed in Belgium/Baltics; product-specific Ukrainian meal/oil supply; existing Kazakh processor upgrade/tolling as local capital alternative. EU crushing of Kazakh non-soy seed shares the origin/EUDR benefit.
deciding_location_factor: Combined crop-specific accepted meal/lecithin/oil realizations less seed opportunity cost, both freight legs, duties, certification, access, working capital and annualized incremental CAPEX versus destination and incumbent processing.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: origin processing with oil east/south and meal west may save westbound oil freight; higher protein/lecithin specifications could add value. Neither regulatory distinction establishes an origin-processing advantage; matched netback UNKNOWN.
scale_view: FACT: older official study reports about 47% utilization, while government plan records 50.4% actual national oilseed utilization in 2025 (S16-S17). Aggregates do not prove plant-specific idle solvent lines. Mixed-crop harvest forecast over 5m t is not allocated seed (S20). Greenfield incremental feedstock UNKNOWN.
physical_constraint_view: UNKNOWN: crop/catchment seed contracts, actual spare modern equipment, utilities, yields/protein acceptance, storage/seasonal finance, Russian transit/port quotes and plant/product-specific Chinese access/timing. No assumed uninterrupted energy or generic CIFER approval.
captured_status: FACT: Qazaq-Astyq advertises 1,000 t/day, high-protein meal and food/feed phosphatide concentrate (S18). Obvious extraction/product capabilities partly captured; standardized/fractionated lecithin and higher-spec upgrade gap UNKNOWN. Foreign upgrade/JV mandate not established.
economic_return_mechanism: INFERENCE: incremental accepted protein/lecithin realization and geographically split oil/meal netback after extra equipment costs. Existing concentrate is not automatically premium lecithin. Do not rely on unverified crush spreads, generic protein equivalence or a soy-lecithin EUDR premium.
cheapest_kill_test: At one accessible existing plant, is there a real paid specification/equipment gap beyond current meal/concentrate output, with enough contracted seed and incremental netback to fund an upgrade?
decisive_evidence: FACT: substantial aggregate spare crushing capacity (S16-S17), existing advanced-output claims (S18), actual export channels (S19), and a tariff distinction shared with destination crushing of Kazakh seed (S21). Subsidiary lecithin EUDR claim is unsupported by the legal scope (S22).
key_unknown: Incremental equipment/specification premium, accessible brownfield partner and crop-specific split-stream netback versus both destination crushing and existing local processing. Boundary verdict: DISTINCT FROM OP-043 as written; advanced-processing capital is essential to that distinction.
next_test_if_uwt: Proposed owner: addendum oilseed commercial reviewer, team to assign. First 60-min one-site asset/spec/seed/partner audit. If an incremental gap exists, 60-min matched crop/date netback using usable quotes for KZ split streams, Belgium/Baltic seed crushing and local toll/upgrade; set speculative EUDR lecithin premium to zero. Access reviewer 45-min buyer/registry/product documentary check; China only if essential, else quote admitted Central Asian oil outlet. No contacts made.
pass_condition_if_uwt: Accessible incremental processing capital serves a paid specification gap without duplicating idle extraction; conservative crop-specific margin covers annualized upgrade investment against destination/incumbent alternatives; accepted EU products and oil outlets have compatible access and timing.
kill_or_park_condition_if_uwt: PARK if only undifferentiated greenfield crushing remains, no accessible upgrade/specification gap exists, or incremental economics are marginal. FAIL only if a documented fatal feedstock/access/cost contradiction eliminates all admitted configurations. Temporary seed restrictions, aggregate idle capacity and absent quotes alone do not kill every brownfield option.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: UWT for the admitted advanced-processing package, with brownfield-first testing. No current greenfield justification. DISTINCT FROM OP-043 only for separable meal/lecithin equipment and specification economics; crop lists, tariff detail or destination changes alone would merely elaborate ordinary crushing. No existing OP modified.
